objective: Increase qualified live participation and profit capture without increasing the fixed account-day loss boundary.

changes: Missing catalyst, sector, analog, float, and numeric dilution context is recorded as UNKNOWN instead of becoming an automatic veto.
Fresh catalyst is not mandatory for the under-$5 lane; verified adverse security evidence remains a hard rejection.
Reference targets are fixed at 1R, 2R, and 3R and are not capped by the ATR capacity heuristic.

The reference campaign starts near $15 risk, builds a profitable strengthened thesis toward $20, and permits up to $30 only when exceptional, profit-funded, and inside any stricter instrument-lane ceiling.
Winner builds use 40/35/25 trigger, profitable-retest, and renewed-expansion stages with open-risk-neutral add requirements.
Core and 20%-30% runner state is persisted with broker-confirmed lifecycle transitions and immutable original-stop history.
Causal relative volume uses prior completed sessions at the same local minute and never falls back to prior full-day volume.
ETFs and fund reference records are included for broker-specific ETF, CEF, and inverse-ETF classification.
Sub-gap emerging leaders are surfaced as ranking context only and never gain entry authority from the watcher.
Quantity and 1R/2R/3R references use the worst reviewed entry ceiling rather than the lower trigger price.
The fixed -$100 loss lock and first +$150 crossing are durable, broker-confirmed session latches with a fail-closed local entry gate.
Position campaigns preserve append-only broker transition evidence, reject backward state changes, and retain prior campaigns across reentry.
Active campaigns are exclusive by account and canonical underlying thesis so competing equity, option, or fund expressions cannot coexist accidentally.
Risk snapshots require an explicit broker-confirmed cash-flow adjustment; a missing value cannot silently become zero.
LULD events synchronously disarm pre-halt candidates, and the second-aggregate path fails closed until valid post-resumption structure is recomputed.
Prepared-plan deduplication includes policy, sizing, target, and management versions so legacy plans cannot suppress the new policy.
Exactly $5.00 remains in the stricter lane; under-$5 liquidity, spread, 0.625-ATR chase, and post-halt rules match the canonical automation.
Unknown score components are neutralized through covered-weight normalization instead of becoming a hidden zero penalty.

validated: Prepared-plan and ledger separation from broker authority
evidence_boundary.research_result: No universal later-exit rule qualified; profit capture remains conditional on structure and execution costs.
